parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located under the tabletop, typically rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or accessories.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide in and out along rails or grooves.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden shelf positioned between the legs of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides additional storage or display space below the tabletop.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A cylindrical wooden leg supporting the front-left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A cylindrical wooden leg supporting the front-right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A cylindrical wooden leg supporting the back-left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A cylindrical wooden leg supporting the back-right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical support and stability to the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop Connector
parts.Basic_description: A wooden frame or connector piece that attaches the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Functional_description: Ensures structural integrity by connecting the tabletop to the supporting legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Serves as the main surface for placing objects, writing, or working.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
